header.title: Travel Guides
heading: Meet our Sri Lanka travel guides
intro: Travel Sri Lanka with experienced local chauffeur guides who speak your language, know the roads, and build each day around your pace.
introBody: At Ceylon JOJO Travels our guides are private driver-guides — not large coach tours. They handle temple etiquette, wildlife park timing, hill-country driving, and flexible stops so your trip feels personal from the first pickup.
team.heading: Guides travellers rely on

why.heading: Private guidance, not a fixed group schedule
why.1.title: Your pace, your stops
why.1.desc: Change a viewpoint, add a village lunch, or skip a crowded stop — your chauffeur guide adapts the day without a coach timetable.
why.2.title: Local road knowledge
why.2.desc: Mountain hairpins, wildlife park entry windows, and monsoon-aware routing are handled for you so you can enjoy the journey.
why.3.title: Language & culture help
why.3.desc: From temple dress codes to bargaining politely at markets, your guide translates the small details that make travel smoother.
why.4.title: Door-to-door comfort
why.4.desc: Private air-conditioned vehicles, hotel pickups, and luggage handling keep multi-day Sri Lanka tours simple from arrival to departure.
tips.heading: Practical Sri Lanka travel advice
tips.1.title: Plan around the seasons
tips.1.desc: The west and south coast are usually best from December to March; the east coast shines around May to September. Cross-island trips can mix both with smart routing.
tips.2.title: Start early for Sigiriya & safaris
tips.2.desc: Climbing Sigiriya or entering Yala earlier means cooler temperatures, softer light, and a better chance of wildlife sightings before peak crowds.
tips.3.title: Pack light layers
tips.3.desc: Coastal days are warm; Nuwara Eliya evenings can feel cool. Bring breathable clothes, a light jacket, modest wear for temples, and comfortable walking shoes.
tips.4.title: Leave room to wander
tips.4.desc: The best memories are often unplanned — a tea-factory stop, a quiet beach, or a village short-eat stall. Keep one flexible slot each day.

cta.body: Choose a tour package or tell us your dates — we will match you with a chauffeur guide and a route that fits your style.
